smyx-pet-detection-analysis 1.0.7

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect latest version and workflow details.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- Made internal updates to utility scripts (util.py) for improved maintainability.

- Internal file changes made to the configuration script (skills/smyx_common/scripts/config.py).
- Removed documentation file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or parameters.
- All core features and usage remain as previously documented.

**Major update: Internalizes user identity handling for enhanced privacy and simplified user interaction.**

- User identity (open-id) is now handled completely internally; users are no longer required or allowed to provide, be prompted for, or see any identity parameter.
- Historical report queries and analysis tasks are always associated with the correct user automatically by the system.
- SKILL.md restructured with clearer process flows, bold privacy and security guidelines, and expanded documentation for easier use.
- All legacy references to manual open-id input or handling have been removed to eliminate confusion and strengthen compliance.
- Two obsolete files removed; related script files updated to align with new identity management and documentation.

- Updated skill version to 1.0.5.
- Documentation improvements in SKILL.md for clarity and usage guidance.
- Minor adjustments to API usage instructions and process flow in SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- Internal updates to scripts for pet detection and related utilities.

Significant refactor and restructuring of the skill.

- Migrated codebase to use a new skills/smyx_analysis/ directory, removing face_analysis legacy code.
- Simplified open-id acquisition: now only supports user-provided open-id and removed config file fallbacks.
- Updated documentation to clarify privacy/data security strategy and reduced maximum media file size to 10MB.
- Updated CLI usage and parameter behavior; attachment handling and output formatting clarified.
- License added (MIT-0).
- General cleanup and modernization across internal scripts and skill structure.

- Updated configuration files: config.yaml, config-dev.yaml, and config-test.yaml have been modified.
- Adjusted logic and utilities in config.py and util.py to match new configuration requirements.
- __init__.py updated, possibly for module initialization or to reflect script restructuring.
- No changes made to user-facing documentation (SKILL.md remains unchanged).
- Improves configuration management and script consistency.

- Added missing version field to SKILL.md metadata.
- No functional or logic changes; documentation update only.
- Ensured documentation and metadata consistency for standard compliance.

- Initial release of the pet detection skill for home monitoring scenarios
- Supports detection of cats, dogs, and birds in both video streams and images
- Features high-sensitivity multi-species recognition, providing real-time and high-precision identification
- Strictly enforces cloud-based report querying with mandatory open-id validation; prohibits use of any local history or memory for reports
- Automatically saves uploaded media files to the attachments directory and outputs structured detection reports
- Provides Markdown table-format summary for historical reports with clickable report links
